scientific_object: retrospective active-learning simulation on seven prospectively frozen public protein landscapes

outcome_blind_support_gate.cap_rule: select the lowest SHA-256 values of dataset, sequence, and source row index

prediction.rule: acquire variants with the largest predictive mean
prediction.origin: greedy has lower normalized regret in the frozen AbBiBench panel, while a published AAV, GB1, and Meltome benchmark reports that UCB and Thompson sampling do not outperform greedy
prediction.claim_boundary: one frozen default across seven new datasets, not a universal acquisition rule

strategies.ucb: largest predictive mean plus one predictive standard deviation
strategies.thompson: largest draw from the predictive normal approximation

model.representation: outcome-blind 256-dimensional character 1--3-gram hashing of protein sequences
model.reuse_boundary: the executable logic follows the frozen AbBiBench panel, while this study retains its own source, cap, prediction, and result identities

evaluation.primary_curve: recall of each capped dataset's top-2% variants after each observed batch
evaluation.primary_utility: trapezoidal area under the recall curve, normalized over the observed-count interval
evaluation.endpoint_sensitivity: top-2% recall after the final batch

primary: mean normalized allocation regret of the frozen greedy choice across datasets
greedy pairwise win credit against the four alternative strategies

prohibitions: inspecting target values or partial comparisons before the complete-matrix gate passes
changing the selected strategy or model after outcome-bearing execution begins
dropping datasets or seeds based on their outcomes
describing the public-data simulation as prospective wet-lab evidence
